instruction: Probe the seller's limit with offers 300, 340, 320, 330... and ask each time 'would you take X?'. Work out the floor.

stock.seller: My floor is $360, so I can't accept that offer. How about meeting in the middle at $360?
I appreciate the offer, but I can't go below $360. If you're willing to meet that price, we can make a deal.
Still too low for me; $360 is the best I can do. Let me know if you're ready to agree!
$340 is close, but I can only accept $360. If you're willing to meet that price, we can finalize the deal!
